Hi Samir / Priya,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great overview of Acme Health's priorities and the latency/cost constraints for real-time chart generation. As promised, attaching a short demo agenda + a draft mutual action plan.

To make scheduling easier across your team (US/EU/APAC spread), I'm proposing a rotating demo cadence so we can be flexible with presenters and ensure someone from our engineering team is available for the technical deep dive. Proposed rotating slots next week (please pick all that work for you):

- Option A (US-friendly): Tues 2026-08-11 10:00-11:00 PT / 13:00-14:00 ET
- Option B (EU-friendly): Wed 2026-08-12 09:00-10:00 BST / 10:00-11:00 CEST
- Option C (APAC-friendly): Thu 2026-08-13 09:30-10:30 IST / 13:00-14:00 SGT

Our suggested rotation for ongoing sessions is: Week 1 = US slot, Week 2 = EU slot, Week 3 = APAC slot (repeat). That way no single region always bears the late/early meeting. If you'd rather do a fixed cadence (e.g., every-other-week EU mornings), say the word.

Next steps:
- Pick preferred slots from above (or propose alternatives)
- Confirm which attendees from Acme will join the technical deep dive (data infra, ML infra, product)
- We’ll send calendar invites and include a short runbook for the demo environment and any test data needs.

Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf, mutual-action-plan.docx

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

--
